aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome for Android led browser versions (mobile) in South America at 75.54% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Safari iPhone ranked second at 15.73%, followed by Chrome for iPhone at 4.9%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browser versions (mobile) in South America?
faqs.answer: Chrome for Android leads at 75.54% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-version-market-share/mobile/south-america.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browser versions (mobile) in South America?
faqs.answer: Chrome for Android (75.54%), Safari iPhone (15.73%), Chrome for iPhone (4.9%) in October 2026.
